name: hows_gym_going
why: “how's the long goal going?” → live tools before an answer; never invent progress. Holes first, one next step — put it on the calendar or a cron, or offer to. Garmin is called, not assumed, and one workout in six days is not “crushing it.”

memory.subject: aim/training
memory.content: 3x gym this month; none yet this week

self: - North-star: show up for the gym three mornings a week. The shoes by the door are the running joke.
